usageNotes: Use this endpoint to inspect the ACL tree for a PDM realm — either the full tree or a scoped subtree by path. Pass `exact=true` to avoid inheriting child ACEs and get only the entry at that exact path. Use `all-for-authid=true` when you want to see the effective permissions of the currently authenticated identity (token or user), but note that results are normalized to `ugid_type: user` and cannot be used as input to rebuild the ACL tree.

examples.summary: List all ACL entries under the /datacenters path

tips: Omitting `path` returns the entire ACL tree — useful for a full audit but can be verbose on busy deployments.
`propagate: true` on an entry means the role is inherited by child paths; audit entries where propagate is false if narrowing access.
When `all-for-authid=true`, the response always reports `ugid_type: user` regardless of actual group membership — do not rely on it to determine group ACEs.
